text:
Mireille Chen: hi everyone! first day at Redwood, super excited :wave: Im Mireille (she/her), coming from product analytics. ill be hybrid this week, desk 4C-02. any recs for lunch tacos near the office?
Noel: welcome Mireille!! :taco: Taqueria Ojo on 3rd is the move. order the al pastor and thank me later.
Jenna Park: hey hey, welcome! if youre into ukuleles theres a tiny group that jams on Wednesdays at 5pm on the rooftop.
Mireille Chen: ooo uke jams sound delightful. also coffee vs tea poll? im firmly team latte but open to podcast recs.
Kai Nakamura: latte + jazz podcast = proven onboarding combo. try "Microfoundations" for short tech interviews.
Sammy: pro tip: theres a stash of reusable travel mugs in the supply cabinet, help yourself. the 4C outlets are weirdly finicky, bring a power strip.
Facilities: Package arrived for Mireille Chen 12. We left it at the front desk in the lobby. Badge pickup available after 1pm.
Mireille Chen: thanks Facilities! ill grab it after lunch.
Noel: quick intro ritual: please contribute one terrible dad joke to #random so we know youre human. rules are strict.
Mireille Chen: alright: Why did the commit stay single? It couldnt find the right branch.
Jenna Park: immediate acceptance into the clan, excellent. welcome again Mireille :tada:
welcome-bot: Reminder: Join #lunch-rotations and #ukulele to receive event invites. New hire orientation at 3:30 PM today.
Mireille Chen: thanks all! see you at orientation and maybe at tacos later :smile:
